title: A batch merges only after a green run against current main
why: Finding, Oct 27 (c95 part 1): a batch could land untested against a main that moved.
note: Built Oct 27: draft PR #659 (merge tool refuses a head that lacks main's tip), head 770d7b4, sent to the build advisor for the batch. merge.py refuses before any claim when the PR head does not hold origin/main, and again after the check wait; the refusal says to merge main into the branch. A records-heal merge commit passes. Fresh Sonnet review round 1: clear. Merge suite: 572 tests pass; three new refusal tests were red on the old code. Record merge-needs-current-base. Branch protection unchanged: turning strict on is shiv's decision. Port: no; the merge tool is shared, so repos that use it get the refusal when they install it.
